matches.excerpt: - Shell is zsh: quote every glob passed as a flag value.

rule.advice: if it keeps firing: make the shell forgiving instead: setopt nonomatch in ~/.zshenv (every zsh reads it), or a PreToolUse hook that quotes flag globs

causes.label: unmatched path glob (zsh no matches found)
causes.fix: zsh: an unmatched glob aborts the command even with 2>/dev/null. List with find or fd, or quote the pattern.

causes.label: pkill -f matched and killed its own shell (exit 144)
causes.fix: pkill -f PAT matches the harness shell, whose command line holds the whole call, and kills it (exit 144). Kill by name (pkill -x NAME) or by a saved PID (kill "$(cat srv.pid)"). A bracketed '[p]attern' helps only when no other part of the call repeats the plain text: pkill -f '[b]un run dev'; bun run dev & still dies.

causes.label: harness blocked sleep N followed by a command
causes.fix: Don't sleep N && cmd: wait with an until-loop (until grep -q DONE f; do sleep 2; done), Monitor, or run_in_background.
